test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

Roshan says, "I have completed my homework."

options.text: Roshan said that he had completed his homework.
Roshan says that he had completed his homework.
Roshan says that he has completed his homework.
Roshan said that he has completed his homework.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** Roshan says that he has completed his homework.
